description: Drift by Wild Light, the winner of the PC 64K intro competition at Assembly '95, running from its original files in your browser.
about: Drift is Wild Light's 64K intro for MS-DOS, which won the PC 64K intro competition at Assembly '95, held from 10 to 13 August 1995 in Helsinki.
It returns to DOS by itself after about 3 minutes 40 seconds.
released: Assembly '95: first in the PC 64K intro competition.
credits: Code by Asmu and Vulture, music by Nobody, graphics by Odd Monk and Preacher (as Demozoo credits them). PMODE by Tran.
terms: Not freeware, by its authors' word: “This material is not freeware. You are allowed to copy it without restrictions for non-commercial use.” (DRIFT.TXT) It also bars any charge for it without the authors' written license, any commercial use, and changes.
accuracy: DosKit picks the Gravis Ultrasound in its setup. Its Sound Blaster Pro choice did not work on the emulated Sound Blaster 16.
Not yet compared with a capture made on real hardware.
Mono: js-dos mixes the two channels into one.
imageAlt: Drift's red landscape, running in DosKit
